ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel values covering approximately 90% of the visible fluke area, contrasted against localized high-intensity (white) clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous circular and ring-like blobs scattered irregularly across both lobes; a dense concentration of high-intensity pixels is localized at the lateral margin of the left lobe and the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible convergence of lobe boundaries at approximately 45 degrees, though the vertex is partially obscured by low-intensity water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged variations on the right lobe trailing edge; moderate-frequency irregular serrations on the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a convex curve ending in a rounded tip; right lobe displays a more linear sweep with a sharp, truncated distal edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast rings (white perimeter, dark interior) distributed across the lower half of the visible ventral surface, particularly dense on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular pixel-level truncation and jagged tissue loss on the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Bright white pixel cluster at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe, contrasting sharply with the adjacent dark tissue and water.
